name: Floating Boy Chasing Running Boy
look: A photo in a school hallway with a black and white checkered floor. A young man with glasses, in a gray and navy shirt, runs toward the camera on the right, while behind him on the left a tall figure dressed in black floats in midair, legs dangling, as if gliding after him.
use: The running boy is someone trying to get away, and the floating boy is the thing relentlessly chasing them, such as a deadline, an embarrassing memory or a responsibility. Labels go on each figure.
slots: label on the floating boy (what is chasing)
label on the running boy (who is fleeing)
examples: The thing I said in seventh grade
The song I heard once this morning
describe: guy floating in the air chasing a kid down a school hallway
levitating person following someone who is running away
creepy hovering dude behind a scared guy in glasses
boy speed walking away from someone gliding after him
school corridor with checkered floor and someone hovering
